Class McpReadToolService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.McpReadToolService
@Service @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="gt.use", name="mcp", havingValue="true") public class McpReadToolService extends Object
The reading tools of the MCP server. Each method calls the same report the user interface uses, through the overload that takes the tenant and the day explicitly, and projects its result into a compact answer.

Every id passed by the client is checked by McpInstrumentAccess before a report sees it. No method changes transactions or master data, and none starts a price download.
